content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD I/O source file (header L3 'FILE io.F', BSD license L5-43). SUBROUTINE OUTPUT (L52) advances SCREEN_COUNT/PLOT_COUNT_STATION/PLOT_COUNT by DT and triggers STATISTICS (L76), STATIONS_SPHERICAL_IJ or STATIONS (L86/L88), and after PLOT_START_TIME (L94) PREVIEW (L99) plus module outputs OUTPUT_VESSEL/OUTPUT_SEDIMENT/OUTPUT_TRACKING/OUTPUT_FOAM (L105/112/119/126) on their own PLOT_COUNT_* intervals. SUBROUTINE READ_INPUT (L149) opens time_dt.out unit 10000 (L180) and LOG.txt unit 3 (L182), takes the input-file name from the command line via GETARG defaulting to input.txt (L190-196), and reads the entire input.txt parameter set through INPUT_READ module routines READ_STRING/READ_INTEGER/READ_FLOAT/READ_LOGICAL with per-key defaults or STOP-on-missing (see params_defined): parallel PX/PY, grid Mglob/Nglob and DX/DY (CARTESIAN) or StretchGrid files / Lon_West,Lat_South,Dphi,Dtheta (spherical); DEPTH_TYPE with DAT/FLA/SLO variants; time controls; hot-start INI_UVZ block; still water level; wavemaker families LEF_SOL, WK_TIME, INI_SOL, N_WAVE, INI_REC, INI_GAU/INI_DIP, WK_REG, WK_IRR/TMA_1D/JON_1D/JON_2D, Salatin et al. 2021 (JGR-Oceans, doi 10.1029/2021JC017641) WK_NEW_DATA2D/WK_DATA2D (L1850) and WK_NEW_IRR with wave-coherence alpha_c (L3506-3768); ABS/LEFT_BC_IRR absorbing-generating wavemaker whose WAVE_DATA_TYPE 'DATA' branch itself opens WaveCompFile (unit 1, L2026) reading NumFreq/NumDir, PeakPeriod, Per_Ser (as frequency, inverted at L2078), Theta_Ser, Amp_Ser and optional Phase_LEFT with END=991 fallback to random phases (L2043-2065); periodic BC; direct/diffusion/friction sponges; WaveMakerCd momentum balance; obstacle and breakwater files; physics flags DISPERSION/Gamma1/Gamma2/Beta_ref/Gamma3, VISCOSITY_BREAKING, SWE_ETA_DEP, friction matrix or fixed Cd; numerics Time_Scheme/CONSTRUCTION/HIGH_ORDER/CFL/DT_fixed/FroudeCap/MinDepth(+Frc merged via MIN at L2948-2949); arrival time OUT_Time/ArrTimeMinH; breaking ROLLER_EFFECT/SHOW_BREAKING/Cbrk1/Cbrk2/WAVEMAKER_Cbrk/WAVEMAKER_VIS (mutually exclusive with VISCOSITY_BREAKING, STOP at L3159-3173); wave-averaged T_INTV_mean/STEADY_TIME/C_smg/nu_bkg; COUPLING_FILE; RESULT_FOLDER created via SYSTEM mkdir -p (L3341-3356); FIELD_IO_TYPE (PARALLEL only, L3330); stations; OUTPUT_RES and ~35 OUT_* output switches (L3385-3424), all echoed to LOG.txt. Station writers: STATIONS (CARTESIAN version L3786) reads STATIONS_FILE i,j pairs (unit 100, L3842-3844), converts to local indices with iista/jjsta offsets (L3849-3850), opens per-station files sta_NNNN (unit 100+i, L3858), and buffers time/eta/u/v (+FOAM eddy/EtaFoam/EtaFoamMax) into ZUV_Buffer of depth StationOutputBuffer, flushing when full (L3905-3939), closing at TOTAL_TIME (L3945-3952); STATIONS_SPHERICAL_IJ (L3969) is the same by i,j for spherical, and spherical STATIONS (L4132) converts lon/lat to indices via nint((dum2-Lon_West)/Dphi) (L4181-4184). PREVIEW (L4304) numbers output files with 5-digit suffix (ykchoi, L4347-4357), writes dep.out and cd_breakwater.out at ICOUNT==1 (L4359-4366), logs time,dt to unit 10000 (L4368), and PutFiles each enabled field: eta, etasrn, AB_OUTPUT grdAx/y grdBx/y, hmax/hmin/umax/MFmax/VORmax, u, v, mask/mask9 via Int2Flo, p, q, age, roller, undertow, nubrk, FrcInsX/Y, BrkSrcX/Y, arrival time, METEO Pstorm/Ustorm/Vstorm, VESSEL Fves/Pves/VesUp/VesVp, SEDIMENT suite (C, Pick, Depo, Pavg, Davg, DchgS/B, BedFx/y, dep, BedStr, Aval, AvalAc plus SEDIMENT_DEBUG fields), FOAM FoamEta, tmp (L4359-4617). PREVIEW_MEAN (L4630) outputs umean/ulagm (P_mean/Max(Depth+ETAmean,MinDepthFrc), L4669), vmean/vlagm, etamean, Hrms/Havg/Hsig, and radiation-stress set Sxx=UUmean-WWmean+0.5*9.8*ETA2mean (L4698), Sxy, Syy, DxSxx..DxUVH, FRCX/Y, BrkDissX/Y (L4696-4735). PARALLEL GetFile (L4751) has rank 0 read the global file with ghost-cell mirror fill (L4770-4793) then distribute subdomain blocks via MPI_Gather of index ranges and mpi_isend/mpi_irecv (L4801-4845). PARALLEL PutFile (L4863) dispatches on FIELD_IO_TYPE to PutFileASCII/PutFileBinary (PARALLEL_FIELD_IO module); serial PutFile (L4894) builds FORMAT_LEN '(<Mglob>E16.6E4)' once (L4907-4910) and writes the interior at OUTPUT_RES stride (L4919-4921). OUTPUT_VESSEL (L4939) appends vessel resistance time series to Resis.txt (unit 99, L4957-4967); OUTPUT_SEDIMENT (L4992) and OUTPUT_FOAM (L5032) are stubs with only first-call folder setup.

verbatim_spans.text: !  07/17/2019  Zhouteng Ye, added 1. get input from command line argument
IF(NO_UV_FILE) NO_UV_FILE = .TRUE.    ! in case you dont have u file
!  merge two parameters into the minimum one, change to min according to Harris 11/13/2023
!  fyshi set blowup value is 100xmax_depth in init.F

unresolved: EtaBlowVal block L3427-3439: the READ_FLOAT is commented out (L3427) but IF(ierr==1) at L3428 still executes, testing stale ierr from READ_LOGICAL(OUT_Radiation) at L3424; EtaBlowVal=10.0_SP here is later overridden by 100x max depth in init.F (comment L3441) — default only applies if that last read failed.

V_FILE branch L768-784: if U_FILE is missing (NO_UV_FILE=.TRUE. at L754) but V_FILE is present, L782 resets NO_UV_FILE=.FALSE. and the guard 'IF(NO_UV_FILE) NO_UV_FILE=.TRUE.' (L783) can never fire since it follows the assignment to .FALSE. — U file would then be read though absent.
CONSTR default is 'HLLC' (L2833) while the log message says 'NOT DEFINED, USE HLL' (L2829-2831); fluxes code tests CONSTR(1:3)=='HLL' which both match.

Phase read L2043 uses END=991: on end-of-file control jumps to label 991 (L2047), skipping both CLOSE(1) (L2045) and label 881 setting INPUT_PHASE=.TRUE. (L2046) — unit 1 remains open in that path; label 881 is never a GOTO target, only reached sequentially.
FDIR is assigned from RESULT_FOLDER at L179 before RESULT_FOLDER is read at L3314, and is not used afterward in READ_INPUT — stale/dead assignment.
Nfreq default differs between wavemaker families: 45 (L1728, L2166) vs 1080 (L3661, WK_NEW_IRR).

Station buffering (L3905-3939, same pattern at L4073-4107, L4240-4274): when the buffer is full the current time step's sample is not stored — the ELSE branch flushes and resets BufferCount to 0 but discards the sample of that call; and the final partially-filled buffer is never flushed before close at L3945-3952 (padding rows pre-set to TOTAL_TIME at L3925).
Random phase generator differs per compiler: rand() for INTEL/CRAY (L2056, L2058) vs rand(0) otherwise (L2060).

ETA_LIMITER (L1835), CrestLimit/TroughLimit (L1837-1838), visbrk/WAVEMAKER_visbrk (L3185-3186), WidthWaveMaker (L2017), R/A_sponge_wavemaker (L2019-2020), NumberStations (L3359) and all OUT_* reads take no explicit default assignment in this file when missing — values rely on module initialization in GLOBAL.
PLOT_COUNT_VESSEL/SEDIMENT/TRACKING/FOAM counters (L102-127) accumulate only after TIME>=PLOT_START_TIME (L94), unlike station counter which runs from t=0 (L81).
